name: boj_get_economic_indicator
description:
One Japanese economic indicator from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis): real GDP (JPNRGDPEXP, quarterly), unemployment rate, industrial production index, or trade_balance, which reads JPNXTEXVA01NCMLM, an OECD goods-exports value series rather than a balance.
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): indicator (gdp, unemployment, industrial_production, trade_balance; default gdp); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations, with no dates looking back N x 45 days; when omitted the whole history in the date range is returned).
For prices use boj_get_inflation; all series: boj_list_series. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"indicator": "unemployment", "start_date": "2018-01-01"}
